title: Andhra Pradesh Partners with IIT Tirupati and UNSW Sydney for Solar CoE
summary: Andhra Pradesh Partners with IIT Tirupati and UNSW Sydney for Solar CoE

items: AP Government partnered with IIT Tirupati and UNSW Sydney to establish a Centre of Excellence for Solar Manufacturing at IIT Tirupati.
